Name: Extra Saloon Space
Author: RaffieJohn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The successor to Saloon Speakeasy Space Mod. Now with only one map and a mini NPC - a singer named Lilly.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]If certain mods are installed, the NPCs will go to the new area.
Currently compatible with:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=http://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31888]Dead Boy Detectives[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37293]The Collector[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34440]The Wayfarer[/url][/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli & Dylan[/url][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url][/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download the zip folder, unzip and place it into the mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a new area in the Saloon that is available immediately upon install.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]IMPORTANT FOR MOD AUTHORS:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]If you like to add your NPC(s) to the Saloon area, you are welcome to. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]If you would like me to add your NPC(s) on my end, please reach out to me in the [url=https://discord.gg/U6G3uvKNMC]Stardew Modmaker Community Discord[/url].[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to everyone who beta-tested the mod, and the mod authors kind enough to let me create compatibility code for their mods.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Extra Saloon Space
Manifest.Description: Adds more space to the Saloon.
